courseId.description: ID of the course this session belongs to.

topicId.description: ID of the topic covered in this session.

teacherId.description: UID of the teacher conducting the session.

studentIds.description: List of student UIDs enrolled in this session.

day.description: Day of the session (e.g., Monday, Wednesday, Friday).

time.description: Time of the session in HH:mm format.

zoomLink.description: External Zoom link for the session.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the session was last updated.

compositeIndexes.description: For querying sessions by course and topic.
For querying sessions by teacher and status.
For querying sessions by student and status.

zoomLink.description: Must be a valid HTTPS URL.

status.description: Must be one of the predefined statuses.
